items.name: School's Out PLU 2022

venue.name: Chris Knutzen Hall - Pacific Lutheran University
venue.details: Knutzen Hall (Room 214) is on the main floor in the Anderson University Center

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SchoolsOutPLU2022#18513-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SchoolsOutPLU2022#18514-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![Image description](https://scontent-sea1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/274121119_10228454031914531_4944819423112613373_n.png?stp=dst-jpg&_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=8631f5&_nc_ohc=oKBGh7KSlKkAX94bJRA&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.xx&oh=00_AT9nAvoePLh3XnW-v1qmhPs3l7K1gWv_eUh3EMhoY36NwA&oe=62637CAC)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)

This is a competition in a series with [Odd Seattle Summer 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OddSeattleSummer2022). You can only register for one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for multiple competitions in this series will result in the organization team choosing which registration is valid on your behalf.
